prompt: On the About page (about.html), under Contact, add a two-step form to book a place on our guided October walk. Step 1, "Your details": "Name", "Email" and "Phone", then a "Continue" button. Step 2, "Invoice": "Name on the invoice", "Invoice email" and "Company (optional)", then a "Book my place" button that shows "Thanks, you are booked." There is no backend; nothing is sent. Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no libraries. Make reasonable assumptions where a detail is missing and finish the whole change without asking questions.
